SRC-108:R001.text: Do not create another broad architecture umbrella.

SRC-108:R002.text: Do not interrupt higher-priority active correctness / closure / field-gate work.

SRC-108:R004.text: If the metrics cache disappears, SAIPEN must be able to reconstruct the useful statistics from canonical durable events where practical.

SRC-108:R005.text: Do not create a second lifecycle database.

SRC-108:R006.text: Do not create one opaque "agent score".

SRC-108:R007.text: Do not create checkpoints solely to improve statistics.

SRC-108:R008.text: Do not invent dozens of micro-categories.

SRC-108:R009.text: Do not duplicate them into another independent taxonomy.

SRC-108:R011.text: Do not attempt to infer private model "thinking time" unless the host exposes a reliable measured value.

SRC-108:R013.text: Do not expose misleading precision when data is unavailable.

SRC-108:R016.text: Do not require every historical ticket to have perfect telemetry before the feature can ship.

SRC-108:R017.text: Do not create many overlapping commands.

SRC-108:R018.text: Do not make the command mutating.

SRC-108:R019.text: Do not make metrics collection depend on the operator calling `stats`.

SRC-108:R020.text: Do not dump the full dashboard into:

SRC-108:R021.text: AUTO_RECALL must remain bounded and execution-oriented.

SRC-108:R022.text: never make canonical lifecycle correctness depend on it

SRC-108:R023.text: A deleted metrics cache must not prevent:

SRC-108:R025.text: Do not introduce mixed naive/local timestamp semantics.

SRC-108:R026.text: Daily grouping may render in the configured/local timezone, but duration calculation must not break across:

SRC-108:R027.text: Duration must come from durable timestamps, not conversation order.

SRC-108:R028.text: Do not build a leaderboard now.

SRC-108:R029.text: Do not count ordinary new user requests as "manual recovery".

SRC-108:R030.text: Do not attempt semantic defect mining from prose.

SRC-108:R031.text: The metrics layer must be cheap.
